what: a probe of tools/qa/probes.ts by what it does to the game between two ticks (tools/blitz/qa-census.py --kinds, by reading); `tools`: the stand-alone tools, by hand; `pins`: the checks that ran with a settled switch off its page value; `waits`: the checks seen red on the Rust game and green on the TypeScript tick, by hand, each with what it waits on; `families` and `unread`: the other names probes.ts knows

tour.ts.why: calls the tick's rules between ticks (kind iii)

soak.ts.why: calls the tick's rules between ticks and wraps a rule's tick (kind iv-a)

tools/qa/exact-check.ts.why: it holds the game's own maths under bun to the same under node, and node has no bridge preload: a check of the TypeScript tick's arithmetic

tools/qa/dice-check.ts.why: it checks the TypeScript die's own rules (src/math/dice.ts: a game with no die draws Math.random, a die put in Math.random's place is followed), which are the TypeScript tick's and go with it

tools/qa/playthrough.ts.why: 84 of 84 missions end the same under both words

tools/qa/seats-run.ts.why: its record, replay and twice lines pass under both words

tools/qa/bench-seeds.ts.why: the same run twice passes under both words on one digest

tools/blitz/thrice.ts.why: three games of one process are one game, each equal to the TypeScript game on every tick

tools/blitz/die-check.ts.why: the game's die seeded after the stand lands on the same word under both

tools/qa/seats-check.ts.why: `rollback` and `twin` hold the game to a word made by walking the JavaScript objects and `down` calls hitPlayer (kinds iv-c, iii): 3 red on the Rust game

tools/qa/lesson-run.ts.why: a lesson's own checks read records the every-tick list lacks and it hangs its own light meter on the game (kind iv-a)

tools/mp/server.ts.why: the game server's check runs on the wall clock (a tick every 16.7 ms): with its export and apply a tick of the Rust game is 27 to 45 ms in each of the check's three processes on a loaded box, and its `lag` line counts the records that came late

tools/mp/bot.ts.why: the game server's check runs on the wall clock (a tick every 16.7 ms): with its export and apply a tick of the Rust game is 27 to 45 ms in each of the check's three processes on a loaded box, and its `lag` line counts the records that came late
